name: auto-model
description: Picks the model per prompt with local rules: quick questions to Haiku, writing and explaining to Sonnet, building and fixing to Opus. The whole conversation always goes along; it switches only when the other model's prompt-cache re-read costs little.

haikuUnderTokens.title: Switch to Haiku under (tokens of context)
haikuUnderTokens.description: While your model's cache is warm, auto-model sends quick questions to Haiku only under this many tokens. Up to ~75k, Haiku's low price tier makes its cold re-read cost about what staying does.

switchUnderTokens.title: Switch up to Opus under (tokens of context)
switchUnderTokens.description: While your model's cache is warm, auto-model moves a heavy prompt up to Opus only when Opus would re-read fewer than this many tokens cold (the whole chat, or what was added since it last ran within the hour): a cold Opus re-read costs $8 per million tokens.
